description: Zebra dichromat matrices. All RGB here is LINEAR sRGB: decode textures with the sRGB EOTF before using them and encode after.
method: rgb_to_LS: Govardovskii et al. 2000 A1 templates x 'Typical CRT Brainard 1997' primaries scaled to sRGB luminance, quantum catch, von Kries to display white. LS_to_rgb: Vienot, Brettel & Mollon 1999 adapted to S/L (blue (0,0,1) and yellow (1,1,0) map to themselves). rgb_to_LS_display_inverse = pinv(LS_to_rgb): recovers [L, S] from a display texture exactly (the display lies in its 2-D range). Night (< 0.02 cd/m2): rod only, shown grey.
